scope: Real Chromium browser interaction with the production Next.js build and real FastAPI routes. Search results are explicitly scripted UI fixtures, not live semantic retrieval.

cases.title: home opens a real Course route and the debug panel toggles with the keyboard
blank questions are rejected locally without sending a search request
success trims the question, disables controls while loading, and renders ordered evidence
Top K changes are sent to the API and replace the old result set
empty candidates clear old results and explain the processing/backfill requirement
HTTP 404 is visible and a later successful search recovers
HTTP 422 is visible and a later successful search recovers
HTTP 503 is visible and a later successful search recovers
a failed network request is visible and retry works
leaving a pending search aborts it and a second Course has fresh state
PDF names and passage markup are rendered as plain text
results stay within the viewport at 375px including long names and unbroken text
results stay within the viewport at 768px including long names and unbroken text
results stay within the viewport at 1280px including long names and unbroken text
